propositions: test_full_backend_account_is_present fails deterministically when scc or lizard is installed on PATH because the test asserts a metric coverage record without controlling optional metric-tool availability
the 50-LOC fixture falls below the 800-LOC threshold, so when scc/lizard is resolved, _metric_invoke returns no match and emits no metric coverage record, causing reconstruction to omit the backend

the sibling test test_metric_backend_skip_is_reconstructable already forces _METRIC_CANDIDATES to a missing binary to decouple test behavior from host PATH, but test_full_backend_account_is_present missed this control

the fix applies the same explicit missing-metric-tool fixture control to test_full_backend_account_is_present to ensure deterministic skipped/no_tool coverage records independent of whether scc/lizard exists on the host
production grounding behavior and evidence schema remain unchanged; a successful tool run with no threshold match must not fabricate a match or abstain
